June, I replied in #strategic-pod thread. Gideon closed ticket #8841 with support on 1 Jul at 09:17, after support fixed a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets. After that fix, the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team.

A 30 Sep GBrain digest describes #8841 differently, as a Newark Door 14 kiosk escalation. That conflicts with the 1 Jul message, so check the ticket with support before the QBR.
